components.name: Download Action
components.description: The dominant primary action: request playtest access on the SLOPArena Steam store page.
components.html: REQUEST ACCESS ON STEAMFREE PLAYTEST · WINDOWS
components.css: .ds-download { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; width:min(380px, 100%); min-width:0; padding:18px 24px; border:2px solid var(--ink, #171814); border-radius:0; background:var(--action-yellow, #FFCC22); color:var(--ink, #171814); box-shadow:7px 7px 0 var(--ink, #171814); text-decoration:none; text-align:center; transform:rotate(-.5deg); transition:transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-download span { font:700 19px/1 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; } .ds-download small { font:700 12px/1.3 'Space Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-download:hover { transform:translate(3px, 3px) rotate(.4deg); box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #171814); } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f05b35); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Feedback Submit
components.description: The compact form action with a physical press response.
components.css: .ds-submit { min-height:44px; border:2px solid var(--ink, #171814); border-radius:0; background:var(--action-yellow, #FFCC22); color:var(--ink, #171814); box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink, #171814); padding:13px 16px; font:700 14px/1 'Space Mono', monospace; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-submit:hover { transform:translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink, #171814); } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f05b35); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-submit:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:wait; transform:none; box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink, #171814); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square, high-contrast field used throughout feedback collection.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-feedback">ANYTHING ELSE?</label><textarea class="ds-field" id="ds-feedback" rows="3" placeholder="Bugs, ideas, and questionable opinions…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--ink, #171814); font:700 12px/1.4 'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:76px; padding:10px; border:2px solid var(--ink, #171814); border-radius:0; background:var(--field-paper, #f4efe3); color:var(--ink, #171814); font:400 16px/1.4 'Space Mono', monospace; resize:vertical; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f05b35); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-field:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: A boxed binary language control with solid active state.
components.css: .ds-language { display:inline-flex; border:2px solid var(--ink, #171814); } .ds-language button { min-width:44px; min-height:44px; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:8px 10px; background:var(--paper, #ded8c9); color:var(--ink, #171814); font:700 12px/1 'Space Mono', monospace; cursor:pointer; } .ds-language button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--ink, #171814); color:var(--paper, #ded8c9); } .ds-language button:hover, .ds-language button:focus-visible { background:var(--action-yellow, #FFCC22); color:var(--ink, #171814); } .ds-language button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f05b35); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Dark Media Card

GAMEPLAY FOOTAGE

HIT PEOPLE. BUILD DAMAGE. SEND THEM FLYING.
components.css: .ds-media { max-width:520px; padding:12px; background:var(--ink, #171814); color:var(--paper, #ded8c9); box-shadow:10px 10px 0 var(--orange, #f05b35); transform:rotate(.7deg); font-family:'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-media-frame { min-height:220px; border:1px solid rgba(222,216,201,.3); background:#292a25; display:grid; place-content:center; text-align:center; } .ds-media strong { max-width:24ch; font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:.12em; } .ds-media p { margin:13px 4px 2px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-media:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--orange, #f05b35); outline-offset:3px; }

components.html: <section class="ds-feedback-panel"><fieldset><legend>RATE THE DEMO</legend><label for="ds-rating">HOW FUN WAS IT?</label><select id="ds-rating"><option>CHOOSE A RATING</option><option>5 — EXTREMELY</option></select></fieldset></section>

narrative.northStar: Low-poly underground toy-fight-club, with DIY internet-game energy.
narrative.overview: The website’s basement-fight flyer is the strongest existing graphic reference, not a complete approved implementation. The shared identity is chunky low-poly, with exaggerated silhouettes and a curated asset-pack collage. Toy means scavenged, hand-built construction—not literal plastic or mandatory cuteness. Keep it slightly crappy on purpose, cool first and joke second, and extremely readable. Harmonize scale, lighting, material response, palette/value hierarchy, and composition without requiring one universal shader. Reject generic esports, cute/cozy styling, generic stock UI, and diffusion gloss or hyperdetail. This sidecar mirrors the approved target in DESIGN.md under ../SlopArena/docs/design/visual-language.md; it is not a separate authority. Website CSS remains chartreuse; native UI retains Baloo and older yellow shades. No runtime migration is claimed. SlopArena is solo-developed, unreleased, and not on Steam; the existing Steam CTA is inaccurate.
keyCharacteristics: Newsprint flyer construction with disciplined layout and hard-edged print offsets.
Action Yellow #FFCC22 for graphic primary actions and selection; preserve character/team colors and blue specials.
Archivo Black name mark and native menu display voice; Archivo Black and Space Mono remain the marketing pairing.
Chunky low-poly forms, authored asymmetry, stable interaction geometry, and preserved character identity and proportions.
Stage themes can vary from industrial places to pools, rooftops, night cities, or tabletop settings.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Action Yellow marks graphic primary action and selection, not character/team colors or blue specials.

rules.name: The Shout and Type Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black is the shared name-mark and native menu display voice; Space Mono remains marketing utility type. Keep dense settings and HUD readable sans.

rules.name: The Structure Before Slop Rule
rules.body: Establish grid, reading order, section boundaries, and stable interaction geometry before authored asymmetry or overlap.

dos: Do harmonize scale, lighting, material response, palette/value hierarchy, and composition without requiring one universal shader.
Do preserve actual character identity, proportions, and chunky low-poly forms.
Do keep the flyer’s rough construction and print offsets controlled and readable.
donts: Don't introduce generic esports polish, cute/cozy styling, generic stock UI, diffusion gloss, or hyperdetail.
Don't use Action Yellow as general decoration or recolor character/team colors or blue specials.
Don't add decoration-only generic grit or replace character art with generic gaming imagery.
